killedBy: the shielded-spawn opacity contract (issue #230) is back at OPAQUE before the shield ends, so an expiring shield cannot dip
why: Drops the ease-OUT half, so the tank is at its most translucent on the last frame of protection and `entities.ts` snaps it to opaque the moment `shieldLeft` hits zero. Issue #230 names this separately from the entrance boundary -- "an expired or absent shield cannot cause a late opacity dip" -- because it is a different frame with a different cause, and the mirrored smoothsteps are what make both structural rather than tuned.
